chapter: Leaving Coltrane: Blakey, Ellington and big bands
title: The Ike and Tina Turner mistake
summary: Tyner firmly corrects a biography's claim that he played with Ike and Tina Turner.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: This period seems to be one where you’re, you know Blue Note, Impulse, record labels, but Woody Shaw recalled that there was a lot of difficulty in getting work at this period in time. One of the biographies I researched said that you had actually played with Ike and Tina Turner during this period, is that correct?
(laughs) I just thought you were returning to your R&B roots because that’s where you started.
See that’s what we want to do, clear the record.
So that is a mistake, that is inaccurate.
Tyner and Turner are two different . . . (laughs)
(Laughs) so you think it was just a mistake of the names?
I would have to change my name to Ike (both laugh)
